Ludhiana Shooting: Former Congress leader Jagjot Singh was attacked by armed men who allegedly opened fire while his mother and 3.5-year-old son were inside the car. Jagjot also alleged that attackers struck him with a sharp weapon. The attack comes amid a series of shootings and targeted killings reported across Punjab in October.
